decisions.reason: Providing a smaller Amazon-upload PDF does not change the required layered PSD, PDF, and JPG deliverable formats.
The source decision concerns Amazon PDF upload size and does not resolve or change the separate D2D cover specification.
PDF file-size optimization does not change the required title typography or the panels that must match.
The smaller-file decision affects Amazon upload reliability, not the Amazon cover's page count, spine width, or output variant.
The source does not alter the tagline text, expected rendering, or required font-portability method.
Optimizing the Amazon PDF file size does not change the blurb content, reflow action, or barcode-clearance rule.
The source authorizes a smaller exported PDF but does not change the constraint against redesigning the existing cover.
